configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Configure filtering settings for the SAP LogServ TA.

entity.label: Enable Filtering
entity.help: When enabled, events matching exclude patterns or older than the configured time window are dropped before indexing (zero license cost). On a single instance, changes take effect after clicking Save. On a deployment server, filter configurations are automatically staged to deployment-apps/ and a Deploy to Forwarders button will appear below to distribute changes to your heavy forwarders.

entity.label: Include Filters
entity.help: Comma-separated fnmatch patterns for clz_dir/clz_subdir values to include. Only events matching at least one pattern are eligible for indexing. Use */* to include all log types (default). Examples: hana/hanaaudit, linux/*, webdispatcher/accesslogs

validators.errorMsg: Include filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Exclude Filters
entity.help: Comma-separated fnmatch patterns for clz_dir/clz_subdir values to exclude. Events matching any exclude pattern are dropped before indexing, even if they also match an include pattern. Leave empty to exclude nothing. Examples: linux/cron, linux/kern

validators.errorMsg: Exclude filters must be less than 4096 characters.

entity.label: Days in the Past
entity.help: Events with a _time older than this many days from today are dropped before indexing. Set to 0 to disable time-based filtering. This prevents backfill of very old log data during initial setup or recovery scenarios.

validators.errorMsg: Days in the Past must be between 0 and 3650.
